pencereler.0-5: A passenger jet dove into the Florida Everglades. A cargo fire burned into the
pencereler.5-12: cabin, and everyone aboard died. The fuel for that fire was in boxes of oxygen generators. They had been
pencereler.12-20: labelled as empty. In fact they were expired but still live, with no safety caps. When one activated, it made heat and
pencereler.20-30: pure oxygen. The hold had no smoke detector and no way to fight fire. Cargo holds now carry detectors and fire suppression.

segmentler.metin: ValuJet Flight 592 crashed into the Everglades after a cargo fire.
It took only expired oxygen generators loaded as cargo without safety caps.
So how could expired oxygen generators loaded as cargo without safety caps do this?

The answer is chemical oxygen generators activating in a cargo hold with no fire detection or suppression — and it is why cargo holds got smoke detectors and fire suppression, and oxygen generators were banned as cargo.
